addr: 3rd Floor, Food court, Mantri Square, 1, Sampige Rd, above Mantri square mall, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Nice experience for my 4 year old kid. Staff is very cooperative, well maintained …physically and mentally kids will enjoy. It’s like a Therapy for them in this busy buzzing world.

The kids’ play area is well maintained and has good quality toys. The setup is colourful and  clean. Kids especially enjoyed the mini kitchen and shopping cart play set. Overall, it’s a safe and fun place for kids to spend time and learn through play.

The play area was child friendly, safe and delightful. My kid enjoyed well. The staff is a bit rude in the outer area. So you have to put up with them. Other than that good option for kids to play in.
